journey.title: A first useful plan
journey.purpose: Go from a fresh account to a reviewable week and a clear next meal through four short setup steps, without the app inventing personal facts or showing demo food as saved data.

steps.intent: Choose a food approach and see the exact exclusions it creates, adding allergies separately.
Pick equipment with the same tiles the Kitchen uses; choosing none is valid.
Answer budget, effort, and variety questions and choose meal slots.
Review how many meals fit, need review, or are excluded, then apply.
Generate a week and review the preview before applying it.
See the next meal with Start cooking and Swap meal.

claims.statement: Setup never pre-fills targets, allergies, stock, or supplement doses from fixtures or memory.
A first plan with incomplete data says what was and was not evaluated instead of showing a coverage badge.
